## SPFxAppCatalogService

Tenant app catalog discovery and site-administrator indicator. Discovery caches a successful URL within this service instance. Concurrent first discovery calls are not deduplicated; failures are not cached. No catalog is provisioned and tenant settings are never mutated.

### Imports (2)

```ts
import type { SPFxAppCatalogService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxAppCatalogService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/services';
```

### Examples (2)

```ts
import type { PageContext } from '@microsoft/sp-page-context';
import type { SPHttpClient } from '@microsoft/sp-http';
import { SPFxAppCatalogService, createSPFxAppCatalogService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

async function exampleUsage(pageContext: PageContext, client: SPHttpClient) {
  const catalog: SPFxAppCatalogService = createSPFxAppCatalogService(client, pageContext);
  const url = await catalog.discoverUrl();
}
```

### Members (3)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SPFxAppCatalogService.canCurrentUserWrite` | `(catalogUrl: string) => Promise<boolean>` | Required | — | Checks the catalog current user's IsSiteAdmin flag, not granular list permissions. |
| `SPFxAppCatalogService.discoverUrl` | `() => Promise<string>` | Required | — | Discovers the tenant app catalog. |

#### SPFxAppCatalogService.canCurrentUserWrite (2)

##### Parameters

- `catalogUrl`: Absolute tenant app catalog URL.

##### Returns

False if the client is missing or lookup fails; otherwise the administrator flag.

#### SPFxAppCatalogService.discoverUrl (2)

##### Throws

- Missing dependencies, failed requests, or an unprovisioned catalog.

##### Returns (2)

Its URL, cached after successful discovery.

## createSPFxAppCatalogService

Creates an isolated catalog discovery cache; no request is made at construction.

### Imports (3)

```ts
import { createSPFxAppCatalogService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { createSPFxAppCatalogService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/services';
```

### Use when

- You need lazy tenant app-catalog discovery or its site-administrator indicator outside React.

### Examples (3)

#### Basic usage

```ts
import type { WebPartContext } from '@microsoft/sp-webpart-base';
import { createSPFxAppCatalogService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

async function exampleUsage(context: WebPartContext) {
  const catalog = createSPFxAppCatalogService(context.spHttpClient, context.pageContext);
  const url = await catalog.discoverUrl();
}
```

#### Discover the catalog and compare its admin indicator

```ts
import type { SPHttpClient } from '@microsoft/sp-http';
import type { PageContext } from '@microsoft/sp-page-context';

import { createSPFxAppCatalogService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
async function demonstrate(context: { spHttpClient: SPHttpClient; pageContext: PageContext }) {
  const catalog = createSPFxAppCatalogService(context.spHttpClient, context.pageContext);
  const url = await catalog.discoverUrl();
  const isCatalogAdmin = await catalog.canCurrentUserWrite(url);
}
```

### Signatures (3)

```ts
(spHttpClient: SPHttpClient | undefined, pageContext: SPFxAppCatalogPageContextLike | undefined): SPFxAppCatalogService
```

#### Parameters (3)

- `spHttpClient`: Caller-owned SharePoint client, possibly unavailable.
- `pageContext`: Current web metadata, possibly unavailable.
